test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which letter will be on the face opposite to the face showing 'B'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/657a0d60774b75f5d82b0c813f68f9b5ab891346e88d442cecd23ef8f2c911db.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a28eaf5cfb85524f1299449b90e702b93620f30e9d21b2181a17b75fc3585ee.png] 

G and R is the opposite sides.

H and C is the opposite sides.

**B and F is the opposite sides.**

So, the face of **'B'** is opposite to the face showing **'F'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
